Cue: "workspace not initialised" error during build or test
Text: Run the bootstrap command to initialize the workspace before executing other make targets.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap"}
```

Cue: Missing database configuration flag in migration command
Text: Always include the --db flag with the appropriate database URI when calling the migration script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db","timeout":30}
```

Cue: Missing required --profile argument in build command
Text: Include the required --profile argument with a value of either dev or prod when calling the build tool.

Failed:
```
error: --profile is required (dev|prod)
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --profile dev","timeout":60}
```

Cue: Using absolute file paths that do not exist in the current environment
Text: Use relative file paths (e.g., "./lib/strings.sh") instead of absolute paths to ensure the file is located correctly.

Failed:
```
Error reading /home/user/repos/evangelyne/lib/strings.sh: open /home/user/repos/evangelyne/lib/strings.sh: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"./lib/strings.sh"}
```
